name: agents
comment: Every task is here, spelled out. `pnpm run` with no arguments lists them. Python tasks run from apps/ because api/__init__.py makes 'api' the importable package name and Python resolves it from the parent directory — which is also what alembic.ini's script_location assumes. The interpreter is the .venv that `pnpm venv` builds; URLs and ports come from .env via apps/api/app/config.py, not from here.

scripts.venv: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r docker/requirements/api.txt -r docker/requirements/dev.txt
scripts.dev: pnpm up && pnpm migrate && pnpm seed && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm api" "pnpm web"
scripts.migrate: cd apps && PYTHONPATH=. ../.venv/bin/alembic -c api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.samples: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work worker python scripts/make_samples.py samples
scripts.ingest: docker compose up -d --wait worker && docker compose exec -T worker python -m api.scripts.ingest_local
scripts.bboxes: docker compose up -d --wait worker && docker compose exec -T worker python -m api.scripts.citation_check
